mod.fpshorizon.name: FPS Horizon
fps_horizon.config.title: FPS Horizon - Configuration
fps_horizon.config.minFps.tooltip: If average FPS drops below this value, render distance will decrease.
fps_horizon.config.maxFps.tooltip: If average FPS exceeds this value, render distance will increase.
fps_horizon.config.fpsSamples.tooltip: How many FPS samples to average before deciding a change. More samples = slower but more stable reaction.
fps_horizon.config.minRenderDistance.too: Minimum render distance in chunks. The mod will never go below this value.
fps_horizon.config.maxRenderDistance.too: Maximum render distance in chunks. The mod will never exceed this value.
fps_horizon.config.cooldownBajar.tooltip: Ticks to wait after DECREASING render distance before evaluating again. 20 ticks = 1 second.
fps_horizon.config.cooldownSubir.tooltip: Ticks to wait after INCREASING render distance before evaluating again.
fps_horizon.config.nieblaActiva.tooltip: Hides render distance changes behind an animated fog curtain.
fps_horizon.config.fogStartBloques.toolt: Distance in blocks where fog starts.
fps_horizon.config.fogEnd.tooltip: Fraction of render distance where fog reaches full density.
fps_horizon.config.fogCierreEnd.tooltip: How tight the fog closes before applying a render distance change.
fps_horizon.config.fogVelocidadLerp.tool: How fast the fog interpolates between states.
fps_horizon.config.cullingActivo.tooltip: Culls chunk sections and entities outside an ellipsoid around the camera, hidden behind the fog.
fps_horizon.config.cullingEntidades.tool: Also applies the ellipsoid test to entity rendering.
fps_horizon.config.cullingRadiusFactor.t: Multiplier applied to the fog radius to compute the culling radius.
fps_horizon.config.cullingExtraBlocks.to: Extra blocks of margin added to the culling radius.
fps_horizon.config.sd_mode.tooltip: Off: manual only. FPS: react to client framerate. MS: react to server tick time (host only). Both: use whichever triggers first.
fps_horizon.config.sdCooldownBajar.toolt: Ticks to wait after decreasing simulation distance.
fps_horizon.config.sdCooldownSubir.toolt: Ticks to wait after increasing simulation distance.
fps_horizon.config.sdMinFps.tooltip: Simulation distance decreases below this FPS.
fps_horizon.config.sdMaxFps.tooltip: Simulation distance increases above this FPS.
fps_horizon.config.sdMaxMs.tooltip: Simulation distance decreases above this server tick time (host only).
fps_horizon.config.sdMinMs.tooltip: Simulation distance increases below this server tick time (host only).
fps_horizon.config.sd_ms_warning: ⚠ MS mode is unreliable in external multiplayer
fps_horizon.config.mostrarDebug.tooltip: Shows a chat message every time render/simulation distance changes.
fps_horizon.config.debugVerbose.tooltip: Shows a live status line with FPS, RD, state, fog and culling info.
fps_horizon.config.manageProfiles.toolti: Open the render distance profile manager.
fps_horizon.profiles.title: FPS Horizon - Profiles
fps_horizon.profiles.name: Name
